verdict.rationale: Treg is a hosted SaaS gateway that holds team accounts, keys, balances and call history, so a full-data export story applies to it. The evidence pack documents no export feature or open-format data dump. Being open-source and self-hostable lowers lock-in, but that is adjacent to exporting your data, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
